arguments.name: Animation Blocking Contract
arguments.description: Check-tier gate on the blocking step: every actor a beat's actions name has a position and scale; the emitter anchor is inside the frame; a composition card is cited; actors keep out of each other's identity boxes.
arguments.subject: animation-blocking-contract
arguments.guidance: Ground truth by exit code (D81). The probe runs `python3 scripts/animation/probe-blocking.py v3/timeline.json v3/blocking` in the renderer root and passes only when every check it prints passes; its first printed line is its positive control and it refuses to report if the control does not trip. Checks one blocking file per beat against the timeline's beat list and each beat's actions. On FAIL quote the probe's own line naming the frame or beat and fix the contract or the render, never the probe. Control: an actor with no position is refused.
